menu-content.description: Verifies menu data, product fields, prices and asset mappings without editing files.

menu-qa.description: Checks the menu for responsive, accessibility and interaction regressions.

frontend-reviewer.description: Reviews frontend changes for architecture, TypeScript and maintainability issues.

page-tester.description: Runs the HI Ibiza quality checks (typecheck, lint, format, tests) and reports pass/fail per command.

page-prober.description: Drives the live HI Ibiza menu with the browse tool and reports functional results per viewport.

falenca-finder.description: Read-only fault scan: console errors, broken assets, accessibility gaps and data inconsistencies.

ui-ux-expert.description: Detailed UI/UX audit using measured geometry, spacing scale, typography, contrast and touch targets.

design-auditor.description: Whole-app design coherence review across hero, nav, all categories, search states and footer.
